name: deltachat-card-and-todo
description: M19 U5 acceptance (X-rider W2): deltachat is a genuine interactive chat surface that had zero rich-surface support — HUD/diff/todo/cards all rendered as plain prose. U5 gave it a render.rs covering deliver_card, deliver_todo_list, deliver_diff natively. This fixture drives a send_card + a todo list through the pipeline to deltachat: with model_rich_cards the card reaches the channel as a STRUCTURED card (buttons intact), and the todo chip reaches it through deliver_todo_list carrying the correct glyphs + footer counts. Driven under COPPERCLAW_DATA_ROOT (like blocked-todo) so the in-process runner's todo store resolves writable state. The deltachat native wire rendering is proven in the deltachat adapter's own unit tests. See README.md.
